title: Independent native product
requirement: End users use the hosted factory in a browser without Claude Code, Codex or another coding CLI, and the service invokes none.

title: Provider capability negotiation
requirement: Anthropic and OpenAI API profiles and any server-reachable OpenAI-compatible endpoint declare and probe streaming, tools, structured output, images, context and cancellation.

title: Authentication, cost and fallback
requirement: User API keys and GitHub tokens stay in the server secret store and out of artifacts, subscription access is not assumed, per-user budgets and the monthly operator allowance stop new work, and fallback respects data destinations and funding source.

title: Create through Mod Setup
requirement: Reuse actual new-mod planning, validation, generated files and apply flow.

title: Import through Mod Setup
requirement: Reuse inspection and preparation of an existing mod, including valid and partial setups.

title: Preserve existing content
requirement: Keep source, binary assets, Git history and existing instruction files of uploaded and GitHub-imported mods unless an exact reviewed change authorizes replacement.

title: Validated workspace handoff
requirement: Pass resolved server workspace roots, version closure, game reference build, capabilities, setup receipt and unresolved checks into the editor and native agent.

title: Intent and approved canon
requirement: Capture lore and constraints with ownership, approval and links to resulting tasks and changes.

title: Optional visual workflow
requirement: Visual, hybrid and autonomous paths operate on the same source and proposal contracts.

title: Progressive interface
requirement: Expose intent, preview, status and meaningful review first, with source and advanced controls available on demand.

title: Source and preview integrity
requirement: Index exact source snapshots and preserve unsupported syntax, comments, ordering and encodings outside approved spans.

title: Useful focus preview
requirement: Render nodes, prerequisites, exclusion, identifiers and diagnostics with explicit fidelity and source revision.

title: Bounded focus editing
requirement: Support source-safe node moves and supported property edits, with explicit refusal for ambiguous or unsupported constructs.

title: Bounded autonomous work
requirement: Run an approved task without canvas supervision, within tool, path, time, cost and change limits.

title: Human intervention and approval
requirement: Pause, revoke or narrow a grant, inspect pending changes and resume safely at a valid boundary.

title: Durable recovery
requirement: Restore tasks, runs, attempts, approvals, evidence and interrupted outcomes after process death.

title: Task dependencies and retries
requirement: Track dependency readiness, ownership, bounded attempts, blocked states and side-effect reconciliation before adding workers.

title: Context and model handoff
requirement: Rebuild a bounded context bundle with provenance and unresolved work when a session or model changes.

title: Memory freshness
requirement: Separate approved canon, accepted project rules, inferred memories and caches, invalidating affected evidence after source or version changes.

title: Reviewable runtime learning
requirement: Capture candidate lessons with evidence and applicability, allowing approval, rejection and supersession without self-granted authority.

title: Git isolation
requirement: Give write tasks owned worktrees or branches in the server workspace and preserve collaborators' uncommitted work.

title: Concurrent edit reconciliation
requirement: Detect textual, semantic identifier and binary asset collisions between humans and agents before merge.

title: Review and attribution
requirement: Offer semantic summary, raw diff, provenance, validation and preview tied to the exact proposed commit.

title: Restore and rollback
requirement: Restore a prior accepted state through an owned reversible operation without discarding unrelated edits.

title: Layered HOI4 validation
requirement: Distinguish syntax, semantics, source render, simulation and actual game observations, with unresolved checks visible.

title: HOI4 integration adapters
requirement: Use versioned tool schemas, health checks, timeouts, cancellation and limited retries for available HOI4 tools.

title: Game and DLC compatibility
requirement: Record the server game reference build, DLC set and ordered content roots, warn when a mod targets another game version, and keep unknown compatibility and stale caches visible.

title: Assets and localization
requirement: Track original assets, rights, transformations, localization keys, consumer wiring and hash-specific review.

title: Existing map inspection
requirement: Inspect layered map data, source relationships and validation without destructive conversion.

title: Structured map import
requirement: Plan and validate an exact structured map import with dependency closure, ID preservation or explicit remapping.

title: Reference image handling
requirement: Keep a map image as attributed design reference until a human reviews a separately validated proposed topology.

title: Map creation and editing roadmap
requirement: Specify bounded painting and later creation or generation with topology, performance, source fidelity and game validation gates.

title: Security and extensions
requirement: Enforce file, process and network authority outside model prose, validate final tool arguments, and treat plugins as untrusted code.

title: Licensing and distribution
requirement: Separate the AGPL-3.0 code license, game rights, provider terms, private data and redistribution decisions, with reproducible pinned Docker images.

title: Contributor collaboration
requirement: Support attributable lore, art, maps and scripting contributions through invited project collaborators and GitHub pull requests, with Git review first.

title: Continuous engineering learning
requirement: Require evidence-based learning reviews after meaningful development, with the smallest useful versioned change or a justified no-change result.

title: Claude-first portable guidance
requirement: Ship AGENTS, importing CLAUDE, real Claude and Codex starter skills, verified discovery paths and no permission escalation by instructions.

title: Source-audited configuration migration
requirement: Map every nonsecret field of the actual Agentic config to verified safe client settings or explicit intentional omission.

title: One-stage handoffs
requirement: Provide self-contained entry, work packets, tests, gates and continuation prompts that stop before the next stage.

title: Research evidence
requirement: Record requested sources, commits, source paths, licenses, inspection scope, factual status and unknowns.

title: Evaluation matrix
requirement: Plan all required scenarios across two API providers and one self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint, measuring accepted output, rework, failures, time and cost.

title: Interoperable extension surfaces
requirement: Use MCP and skills appropriately, consider ACP as optional editor interoperability, and keep the native runtime replaceable.

title: Versioned maintenance
requirement: Pin dependency closures and schemas, test upgrades, track source compatibility and retire stale guidance.

title: Editable export and escape hatch
requirement: Allow the mod to be downloaded, cloned or pushed to GitHub and continued outside the factory, with valid native files and no proprietary source lock-in.

title: Complete planning archive
requirement: Deliver substantive specs, stages, evidence, starter files, traceability and actual package validation in the versioned ZIP.

title: Accounts and tenant isolation
requirement: Public sign-up through GitHub or verified email, per-account and per-project isolation of workspaces, agent runs, secrets and budgets, project roles for invited collaborators, private or public projects with license-respecting copies, a 30-day deletion grace period, and abuse and rate limits.

title: GitHub integration
requirement: Work with GitHub entirely inside the app: connect selected repositories, import or upload mods, create repositories, push branches, and use issues, pull requests, reviews, comments, labels, checks and merges, mirrored from GitHub by verified webhooks, with every write separately authorized and reconciled.

title: Server game reference
requirement: A read-only full game copy, latest build with all DLC, used for validation and previews, never exported or baked into images, with the rights review completed before public exposure.
